decision.reason: [ev-a2a020af7830] says `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count` was renamed to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_total`. But the same 1.17 Changed Metrics section also says it was renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_only_identities` [ev-57fea1f2c18e]. The sibling metrics have the same conflict ([ev-eaf366d94d17] vs [ev-7ede52ce8bb8]), so the evidence does not show which name 1.17.0 actually uses. Separately, the proposed subject puts a Prometheus metric under protocol-behavior with an underscore name, but free-form names in that family must be kebab-case, and it is unclear that this family fits a metric at all. Settling the change needs release artifacts or the metric's source definition at v1.17.0 showing the final name.
